''See also: [[Wei Mon Teris Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Wei Mon Teris is a member of the [[Wei clan]] and belongs to the [[Mon family]]. A year younger than [[Lindon]], he is a [[Copper]]-stage [[sacred artist]] specializing as an [[Enforcer]], a role that allows him to utilize his [[madra]] to increase his physical speed, toughness, and strength. Although he has not yet reached the [[Iron stage]], his ability to channel power makes him a dangerous individual. Teris has a history of conflict with [[Lindon]], including several instances where he lost his temper. During an encounter with a Remnant{{!}}tree-Remnant, Teris fled from the danger, leaving [[Lindon]] unprotected. Following this incident, Teris attempted to manipulate the truth when reporting the event to the [[First Elder]], claiming he had taken a blow intended for [[Lindon]] to protect him. However, his actions were ultimately judged as cowardice, resulting in a public punishment of three lashes delivered by the [[First Elder]]. Despite this disgrace, he remains part of the [[Mon family]], which is overseen by his father, [[Wei Mon Keth]].}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Wei Mon Teris is a member of the [[Mon family]] and the cousin of [[Lindon]]. As a [[Copper]]-stage [[sacred artist]] and [[Enforcer]], he utilizes [[Copper]] [[madra]] to enhance his speed, toughness, and strength. He is known to wear [[snowfox]] skin. Following a period of discipline, he was punished by the [[First Elder]] with three whippings, isolated meditation, and a withheld stipend.}}
